skill.summary: MERGE Trap - `MERGE` matches the FULL pattern—`MERGE (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b)` creates duplicates if relationship missing - Safe upsert: merge nodes separately, then merge relationship - Use `ON CREATE SET` and `ON MATCH SET` f
